description: Start a deep diagnostic investigation into why something is not working the way the user expects (missing run proposals, unexpected signals, unexplained errors). Requires Write scope to persist and enqueue work. Runs in the background for a few minutes; the result is delivered as a notification and is readable via get_diagnostic_investigation. Use only after the deterministic reads (such as get_data_readiness) cannot explain the behavior. Returns deduplicated=true when an equivalent investigation is already running.

correlationId.description: Correlation id from a failed request's error toast, if the user has one.

errorSignature.description: Normalized error signature from an error-invite message, e.g. "POST /api/v1/run-proposals -> 500". Pass verbatim when present.

question.description: The user's question, verbatim plus any context you can add.

name: request_diagnostic_investigation
title: Request Diagnostic Investigation
